nodes.title: SG-8.3.1 Rewrite the repo-root context.md to the real stack
nodes.body:
Context: context.md still describes a README-only repo (Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns, Traceability index). Desired behavior: it names TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Radix, Zustand and Vitest, marks the Go backend out of scope, and has a module table covering game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/. Expected result: both context.md unit tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts pass. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo-root context.md, when missingTerms(text, STACK_TERMS) runs, then it returns [].
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then it lists game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ and every path exists on disk.
- Given context.md, then it contains none of: hello Worldseed, Traceability index, Frameworks: UNKNOWN, the Executable / server / CLI main UNKNOWN row.


## Scope
- In scope: Stack and module-table content of repo-root context.md
- In scope: Docs-check helpers that read it
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and contribution/round API
- Out of scope: Gameplay, content or art changes
- Out of scope: GDD page content
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0
- Preserve: All existing tests, none deleted or skipped
- Preserve: api/client.ts endpoints and payloads


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0; phaser-pin guard test keeps passing
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- Zustand store is the only owner of GameState
- backend/ (Go) and contribution/round API out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external


## Definition of done
- Both failing context.md unit tests pass
- Typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

- Out of scope: Module table

- Preserve: STACK_TERMS values

- backend/ (Go) out of scope
- Tests mock only what is external

- Stack terms test passes

- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md has a real module table and no README-only text
nodes.body:
Context: module table lists only README.md and .gitignore. Desired behavior: table rows cover game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ with roles; Purpose, Entry points, Workflows, Scan meta, Residual unknowns and Traceability index README-only text are removed. Expected result: module paths and stale text test passes. Why: layout must match the repo.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then the result contains game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/.
- Given each path from contextModulePaths, when checked with existsSync from the repo root, then missingPaths returns [].
- Given context.md, then it does not match /hello Worldseed|Traceability index/ nor the Executable / server / CLI main UNKNOWN row.


## Scope
- In scope: Module table
- In scope: Removal of stale sections
- Out of scope: Stack wording
- Out of scope: backend code
- Out of scope: GDD content
- Preserve: contextModulePaths first-seen order and dedupe behaviour


## Technical constraints
- backend/ (Go) out of scope
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- No source file over 200 lines


## Definition of done
- Module paths and stale text test passes


## Clarifying questions
- None
